data.name: Soul Containers
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Soul Containers program!

Nicolas life seemed perfect - his own house, a fiancée and a well-paying job. One day changed everything. His fiancée vanishes without a trace, and the only clue is a game that should never have existed...

The moment you open your eyes, you feel a sense of unease. The daily wake-up in Evelyn's warm embrace is replaced by a cold sense of loneliness. Not expecting anything out of the ordinary, you decide to go about your day as usual. Laundry, cleaning, shopping. On your way back home, you come across a flea market that catches your eye.

You learn that your favorite childhood game developer has just committed suicide. His belongings are being sold at the market to help his mother dig herself out of debt.

Your eye is drawn to one particular item... The only copy of what is likely his newest, unreleased project - a continuation of a classic from years ago. You win the auction. It was the biggest mistake of your life.

A few hours spent in the game fly by - a weird, buggy production full of bizarre glitches. Time for bed. When you wake up, you realize Evelyn never came home at all that night.

The only thing left to occupy your mind is that strange game. In it, amid the digital noise and seemingly random errors, you begin to sense something... more. Traces of someone's presence. Whispers that sound all too real.

Soul Containers is an emotional thriller that bridges two worlds, where your obsession with finding a loved one becomes the key to a dark truth. Controlling Nicolas in the real world, you try to gather as much information as possible by engaging in dialogues with characters. When you dive into glitch-ridden program, the gameplay transforms intro a mix of 2.5D platforming, monster combat and puzzle-solving.

  • Bridge the realities: Explore the world through Nicolas's eyes - inspect his home, roam the city in full 3D. Then, jump straight intro the world of Soul Containers in stylized 2.5D and meet pixel-art creatures! Could these two worlds be connected?

  • Make impossible choices: Your decisions have consequences in both worlds. Who can you trust on your path to uncovering the truth?

  • Meet the people trapped in the program: Each has a unique personality. Engage in dialogues and decide which character will help you reach your goal - and which ones you should avoid. HELP THE TRAPPED SOULS BREAK FREE.

  • Uncover HIS secret: Delve deeper into the program and gradually reveal the dark truth behind technology meant to grant immortality - now a prison for lost souls. Solve environmental puzzles, fight creatures haunting the virtual village, and build relationships with the right npcs TO GET OUT OF HERE.

  • Experience an unforgettable story: The game focuses on Nicolas's tragic story as he slowly loses not only his sanity but also those closest to him. Explore his thoughts, feelings, and pain - walk the entire journey inside his mind and out.

  • KILL ?????????????????: ?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  • Embark on an amazing adventures! ^^

Made in Poland - F*ck AI

data.short_description: Your life collapsed in a single day. Your fiancée vanished, and the only clue is a strange game you bought at a flea market. It was the biggest mistake of your life. A glitch-ridden game, yet it holds more than code - whispers, traces of a presence... and a truth you'd rather not have uncovered.

English*, Polish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, Intel Core i7 4790
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game addresses themes of suicide, self-harm, mental illness, and manipulation. These elements are depicted on-screen and may cause distress. While the portrayal of suicide is treated with seriousness, its visual content may momentarily unsettle players during gameplay.
